_help._about: Explanations for every key above, keyed by dotted path. Code never reads this object. wa_setup.py init writes live/config.json from this file without it. Placeholders: <home> is paths.home, <live> is paths.live_dir, <payload> is the installed skill folder, <auto> is detected at load time. The full reference with the station that sets each key is references/config-reference.md.
_help.my_phone: Your own WhatsApp number, digits only with country code, no plus sign. Asked in station C1 because auto detection is unreliable. Used for mention detection.
_help.my_names: How people address you, for mention detection and prompts. Latin names match whole words only.
_help.owner_label: How prompts and person notes refer to you, for example your first name.
_help.owner_marker: Two to six ASCII letters, usually your initials. Used in voice tags and in the comment markers that lock your own lines in person notes.
_help.direct_policy: all: every one to one message can wake the brain. skip: one to one chats never do (only test runs and board buttons).
_help.group_policies: Group whitelist keyed by group jid: {"policy": "all|mention|skip", "name": group name, "in30": 30 day message count, "defaulted": true when you never chose it yourself}. Build it from wa_setup.py measure. Changes need a daemon restart.
_help.unlisted_group_policy: Policy for groups not in group_policies (new groups, quiet groups): all, mention or skip.
_help.ignored_jids: Chats that are never considered, never read into runs, never backfilled.
_help.debounce.quiet_seconds: A burst starts after this many seconds without a new message in that chat.
_help.debounce.max_wait_seconds: A burst starts at the latest this many seconds after its first message, even if messages keep coming.
_help.debounce.global_concurrency: How many brain runs may run at the same time.
_help.doorbell.enabled: false: the daemon keeps scanning and logging (skip:doorbell_off) and marking your replies, but starts no automatic runs; commands and the board still work.
_help.doorbell.wal_path: WhatsApp Desktop write ahead log that the doorbell watches. <auto> is ChatStorage.sqlite-wal in the WhatsApp group container.
_help.doorbell.poll_seconds: How often the doorbell checks whether the database file changed.
_help.doorbell.stale_alert_hours: Push an error when the WhatsApp database has not changed for this long (WhatsApp Desktop probably logged out or quit).
_help.doorbell.full_rescan_seconds: Query the database at least this often even when the file looks unchanged.
_help.doorbell.lookback: How many message ids behind the watermark each scan looks for messages written late. At first start these are recorded as skip:before_install, never judged.
_help.doorbell.max_message_age_hours: Inbound older than this is logged skip:too_old instead of judged (guards against a flood after WhatsApp Desktop is linked again). 0 turns the gate off.
_help.brain.model: Model for the per burst judgment run.
_help.brain.cwd: Empty working folder for headless claude. Must stay outside Documents, Desktop and Downloads.
_help.brain.context_days: Days of one to one history read for a full (grounding) run.
_help.brain.group_context_days: Days of group history read for a run.
_help.brain.run_timeout_seconds: A claude run slower than this is killed and counted as failed.
_help.brain.retries: Extra attempts after a failed run.
_help.brain.sweep_timeout_seconds: Time limit for the reader that builds a run's conversation pack (voice transcription included).
_help.brain.max_turns: Turn limit for a judgment run.
_help.brain.warm_days: When a chat already has a summary, only this many days of raw messages are read.
_help.brain.ground_every_days: Force a full read of context_days at least this often per chat.
_help.brain.whisper_model: Whisper model folder used for voice notes. Keep the copy under ~/.cache (a model under Documents stalls under launchd). wa_setup.py init fills it when it finds one model folder.
_help.brain.whisper_language: Language hint for transcription, for example zh or en. Empty lets whisper detect.
_help.brain.transcribe: false turns voice transcription off everywhere (runs, board, reader).
_help.brain.gate_probe_seconds: While the brain cannot be called (login expired or usage limit reached, two failures in a row), seconds between the small probe calls that check whether it answers again. Pending messages stay queued meanwhile. Minimum 60. Changes need a daemon restart.
_help.bin.claude: Absolute path of the claude CLI. <auto> searches PATH plus the usual install folders. wa_setup.py render-claude-wrapper sets it to <home>/bin/claude-bot when the daemon uses a setup token instead of the Keychain login.
_help.bin.python: Python that runs every module. macOS system python 3.9 is the tested one.
_help.bin.node: Absolute path of the node binary that launchd starts. This exact binary needs Full Disk Access.
_help.bin.ffmpeg: ffmpeg, used to convert voice notes before transcription.
_help.bin.lark_cli: lark-cli, only needed when a Lark adapter is chosen.
_help.bin.path_env: PATH given to the daemon under launchd. <auto> is built from the folders of the binaries above plus the system folders.
_help.paths.home: The kit's working folder on this Mac (reader snapshots, transcript cache, launchd copies, live/). Keep it outside Documents, Desktop and Downloads.
_help.paths.live_dir: Daemon folder: config, state database, logs, runs, commands, prompts.
_help.paths.vault: Root of your second brain vault. Empty means no vault features.
_help.paths.people_dir: Folder of person notes inside the vault (station C4).
_help.paths.doctrine: Your vault's structure law, read for the person family roles and required keys.
_help.paths.person_playbook: Your vault copy of the person dossier playbook. Person notes need it.
_help.paths.intake_buffer: Append only intake buffer note in the vault (station O7). Same file as intake.buffer; set one of them.
_help.paths.filing_log: Vault filing log that gets one line per person note rewrite. Empty skips the line.
_help.paths.decisions_dir: Vault Decisions folder, where each default you change is logged as a decision.
_help.paths.reader_dir: Where the reader skill scripts are found. <payload> uses the copy inside this kit.
_help.paths.dossier_dir: Where the person dossier skill scripts are found. <payload> uses the copy inside this kit.
_help.vocab.worlds: Which world a conversation belongs to. key is stored, label and label_en show on the board, business marks worlds that have stages.
_help.vocab.stages: Stages of a business conversation, in forward order. The brain only moves a stage forward; moving back is done on the board.
_help.vocab.park_from: Stages from which a quiet conversation may move to parked.
_help.vocab.priorities: How urgent the next move is. Re judged every run.
_help.vocab.business_context: One paragraph written with you in station C2: what each business world sells, price points, how people pay.
_help.stage_rules.parked_after_days: A business conversation in a park_from stage with no messages for this many days moves to parked. 0 turns it off. Needs a stage with key parked.
_help.stage_rules.group_date_done: true marks a group done when a date in its name has passed. Needs a stage with key done.
_help.board.bind: Address the board listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 and reach it through tailscale serve; never 0.0.0.0, the board has no login.
_help.board.others_days: The Others list shows chats active in the last this many days.
_help.board.others_limit: Maximum rows in the Others list.
_help.board.show_usd: Show run cost in USD on the board.
_help.notify.outlet: Where alerts go: none (log only), telegram (telegram_file) or command (a shell command reading the text on stdin).
_help.notify.mode: off, errors, needs_me or all. Start with errors.
_help.notify.telegram_file: JSON file with bot_token and chat_id. Keep it 0600.
_help.notify.command: Shell command for outlet command, for example an osascript notification or an ntfy call.
_help.dossier.enabled: Write and refresh person notes in the vault (station C4).
_help.dossier.model: Model for person note runs. Heavier than the brain; pick a lighter one if your plan cannot carry it.
_help.dossier.auto_open_worlds: World keys whose people get a new person note automatically once they reach auto_open_min_stage.
_help.dossier.auto_open_min_stage: Stage key from which a new person note is opened automatically.
_help.dossier.pack_days: Days of history read for a person note run.
_help.dossier.nightly_at: Local time of the nightly person note refresh.
_help.dossier.nightly_min_msgs: A person with at least this many messages that day (or a stage change) is refreshed that night.
_help.dossier.nightly_cap: At most this many person notes are rewritten per night.
_help.dossier.stale_days: Also refresh a note not rewritten for this many days when the person was active in that window.
_help.dossier.min_gap_hours: Minimum hours between two rewrites of the same person note.
_help.dossier.recent_lines: How many machine recent lines a person note keeps.
_help.dossier.max_turns: Turn limit for a person note run.
_help.dossier.run_timeout_seconds: Time limit for a person note run.
_help.facts.enabled: Run the nightly facts job (station O1).
_help.facts.source: none, csv (a local CSV or a published CSV link) or lark.
_help.facts.at: Local time of the nightly facts job.
_help.facts.phone_default_cc: Country code added to local numbers that start with 0, digits only.
_help.facts.phone_valid: Optional list of accepted number shapes, for example "60:11-12" (country code and lengths); numbers outside it are listed as mismatches, matching still works.
_help.facts.label: Name of your facts source in the brain's lines and person notes, for example Sales sheet. Empty shows CSV or Lark.
_help.facts.currency: Currency of amounts that carry none, for example MYR.
_help.facts.recent_days: Days of WhatsApp messages counted per person in facts.json.
_help.facts.floor: Lowest stage a paying person is shown at: paid (own payment), paid_attended (paid and attended), via_attended (someone else paid, this person attended). Values are stage keys; an unknown key means no floor for that case.
_help.facts.csv.path: CSV file path or published https CSV link (a list of them is also accepted).
_help.facts.csv.columns: Maps standard fields to your CSV headers. phone is required; name, paid, amount, currency, method, date, product, attended and record_id when your file has them.
_help.facts.csv.day_first: true reads 03/04/2026 as 3 April, false as March 4.
_help.facts.lark.people_tables: Lark tables that list people (ids and field names).
_help.facts.lark.payment_tables: Lark tables that list payments (ids and field names).
_help.second_source.enabled: Run the nightly pull from a second message source (station O2).
_help.second_source.at: Local time of the nightly pull.
_help.second_source.lark.whitelist: JSON file listing which Lark chats are pulled. Missing or unreadable is an error, not zero chats.
_help.calendar.destination: none (no button), ics (writes an .ics file the board opens) or lark (station O3).
_help.calendar.lark.calendar_id: Target Lark calendar id; the only calendar the kit ever writes to.
_help.backup.dest: Backup folder: iCloud Drive, a Google Drive folder or an external disk.
_help.backup.require_process: Name of the sync client that must be running before a backup, for example a Drive client. Empty skips the check.
_help.backup.at: Local time of the nightly backup.
_help.backup.keep: How many dated backup folders are kept.
_help.digest.at: Local time of the morning digest.
_help.digest.push: Also push the digest through notify.outlet.
_help.intake.enabled: Append things asked of you to the intake buffer (station O7). false stops every intake writer and the evening push.
_help.intake.buffer: Intake buffer note path. Same file as paths.intake_buffer; set one of them.
_help.intake.evening_push: Install the evening job that pushes the open intake entries with a suggested place each.
_help.intake.evening_at: Local time of the evening intake push.
_help.intake.rules_file: Optional note that says where each kind of intake entry usually belongs; the evening push reads it to suggest a place. Empty uses default places.
_help.voice.enabled: Learn your voice from drafts you edited before sending.
_help.voice.examples: How many draft and sent pairs are shown to the brain as examples.
_help.voice.pairs: File that keeps the draft and sent pairs.
_help.backfill.days: Days of history read when backfilling summaries (station O9).
_help.backfill.min_msgs: Only chats with at least this many content messages in backfill.days are backfilled.
_help.backfill.respect_gate: true backfills only chats the gate lets through (direct_policy, group_policies, unlisted_group_policy).
_help.backfill.max_turns: Turn limit for one backfill batch (every image the model opens costs a turn; the brain's 12 is too few for a batch).
_help.backfill.max_images: How many image or file paths one backfill batch keeps (each chat's newest first); the other media lines lose their path, so the model cannot open more.
_help.launchd.label: LaunchAgent label of the daemon. Change it only to run a second, separate install.
_help.launchd.intake_label: LaunchAgent label of the evening intake job.
_help.calendar.timezone: IANA zone for timed events (for example Asia/Kuala_Lumpur). Empty: the zone macOS uses.
_help.dossier.backups_keep: Copies per person note kept in live/dossier-backups; what is on disk is backed up before every placement.
_help.person.roles_with_stage: People holding one of these roles carry a stage; must share values with the roles in your doctrine's person family.
_help.person.paid_stages: Stages a person note may hold only with a payment record from the facts source.
_help.person.house_punctuation: true: long dashes and spaced hyphens in a new note become commas before it is placed.
_help.second_source.label: Name of the source in prompts and the digest. Empty: the implementation's own name.
_help.second_source.id_key: Person note frontmatter key holding this source's sender ids. Empty: the implementation's own (lark_id for Lark).
_help.second_source.world_by_chat: Chat id to world key: a fixed world guess for that chat.
_help.second_source.world_keywords: Word to world key: world guess when a chat title holds the word.
_help.second_source.prompt_max_chars: Size limit of the nightly prompt's message area.
_help.second_source.map_roles: --probe-members lists person notes with these roles for id mapping. Empty: notes without the id key.
_help.second_source.name_stopwords: --probe-members ignores these words when matching names.
_help.second_source.lark.owner_ids: Your own Lark ids. Empty: read from lark-cli auth status.
_help.second_source.lark.page_limit: Page size of each Lark message list call.
_help.second_source.lark.timeout_seconds: Time limit of one lark-cli call.
_help.second_source.lark.skip_chat_ids: Chats never pulled, whatever the whitelist says.
_help.second_source.lark.system_name_patterns: Chats whose names hold one of these words are never pulled.
_help.reader.index_dirs: Vault folders the second brain lookup indexes (relative to paths.vault). Empty: the whole vault.
_help.reader.exclude_dirs: Vault folders never indexed (relative to paths.vault). An empty list means the reader's defaults, which are the values shown.
_help.reader.low_priority_dirs: Vault folders whose weak name hits are ignored. An empty list means the reader's defaults, which are the values shown.
_help.reader.stop_words: Extra words never used as name keys (your company and brand names).
_help.reader.keep_snapshot: true keeps the reader's database snapshot after each read (debugging only; it is a full copy of your chats).
_help.reader.read_documents: true: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, ODT and Pages attachments are converted to text in the reading pack (cached in <home>/doc-text-cache). false: they show as file names only. Takes effect at the next run.
_help.person.section_roles.gaps: Heading whose numbered questions count as open gaps (the board shows the count).
_help.person.section_roles.notes: Heading whose items may never be lost when a note is rewritten.
_help.person.section_roles.owner_notes: Heading of the owner's own words: every line stays word for word (<marker> is owner_marker).
_help.person.section_roles.recent: Heading of the machine recent block the daemon appends to.
_help.person.section_roles.facts: Heading of the machine system records section written from the facts source.
_help.person.section_roles.next_message: Label of the line the board shows as how to open the next message.
_help.person.section_roles.privacy_hint: A word of the fixed privacy line at the end of a note; a note without it gets a warning.
_help.reader.person_dirs: Extra vault folders whose notes count as people for the second brain lookup (the People room and Decisions are always included).
